_spec_ref: PROJECT_META v3, Teil A.5 - FROZEN. Changing any value here invalidates the baseline.

supersedes.note: The v2 package referenced by A.5 is not present in this repository (zero commits at bootstrap). Its hashes cannot be reproduced or regressed against. Baseline v3 is a fresh, self-declared baseline. Any comparison of v3 numbers against v2 numbers quoted in PROJECT_META (199000 EUR median, 222 EUR / 554 EUR convention spreads, the G3 rank ordering) is NOT a validated regression.

return_convention.note: No additional -sigma^2/2 term. Consequence: g_annual is the MEDIAN annual log growth; the arithmetic mean of the simulated return exceeds g_annual by sigma^2/2. This is the frozen convention and must not be 'corrected'.

terminal_sale_timing.note: first_business_day_y_plus_1 falls AFTER the deemed accrual of the final Vorabpauschale (first working day of the following calendar year), so the terminal Vorabpauschale is triggered. last_trading_day_y avoids it. This is the mechanical source of the G7 terminal-timing spread.

rebalancing.note: Rebalancing is funded per funding_convention. Phase 1 runs 100% CORE, where rebalancing is a no-op.
